items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was like Specks Powell, the drummer at CBS. ... Almost any of the drummers who played for Bud, like Specks Powell was excellent at that because he works for CBS.

ctx.x: Not at all. He was sincere, dedicated, honest, but not arrogant. He was one of these kind of drummers who could adjust. He had several different levels of performance which most drivers don't have. He could play any style you wanted to hear. He could play style that used every four beats on the bass drum, which almost nobody uses anymore. He could play that if you wanted to hear it. He could play the other style where he played sparsely on the bass drum, and mostly with his snare. He was a great brush man. He was…
I was going to say that, show drummer.
